themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe continue to advocate for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to social benefits, housing, and employment. This theme is strongly evident in Spain, Italy, and France, with Vox, Lega, and Rassemblement National leading the charge.
